subject: Build audit: regens done (C21 005/010 v002, E19 015 v002 / 004 v003), brief + CSV on D:
body:
Build/proportion audit: the regenerations are done and on D:. Nothing on D: was overwritten or deleted.

Brief and CSV, identical copies at the root of both archives:
- D:\Documents\CFA\docs\notes\downloads\GROK-HD-FALCON-1000\ and ...\GROK-HD-ENABLERS-03\
- NOVA-BRIEF-BUILD-AUDIT.md  sha256 551614b6e7e40517a81fb16da0d6b21e7de6bd5400fc65bae62d7c43f333bde6
- HD-BUILD-AUDIT.csv (merged: Falcon plus Enablers rows)  sha256 396e11db721f097bccf5ae71a4517b91a7537cb508fb1e6d1a2519df0cd0583b

Summary:
- Rule: a character rendered bulkier than its reference sheet loses 1 L point. 1,713 Falcon and Story Set drafts were checked. Falcon has 2 changes and Story Set 02 has 0. Enablers were checked from contact sheets, with the E03-E09 close-ups skipped.
- Falcon C21-chewy-holds-room: 005-v001 and 010-v001 are rejects (Chewy bulkier than DJB-02). The working images are 005-v002 (L4 S5, sha 1aa15fb96b9ab185...) and 010-v002 (L4 S5, sha ddbb8de7c13f0cfa...). In both, the bandolier came out as a studded strap.
- Enablers E19-boss-dais: 015-v001 and 004-v001 are rejects (boss about twice BOSS-008's bulk). The working images are 015-v002 (L4 S5, sha 763ccbb2567a1307...) and 004-v003 (L4 S5, sha 1ae4ffb8706afcce...; the eyepiece side is unclear in profile). 004-v002 (L3 S4, eyepiece missing) is kept.
- Each newest version replaces its v001 as the working image. The v001s go to the reject/prototype pile, and their history is kept.
- On D:, the original unsuffixed files (C21 005 and 010, E19 004 and 015) are still present. Their hashes are verified identical to the -v001 copies, and the folder NOTES.md files say so.

Request to Nova: update the metadata (likeness, "build drift" defect, working/reject status) for these files only. Do not re-ingest folders.

The MANIFEST and SHORTLIST were rebuilt for both archives. The SHORTLIST excludes the v001 rejects.
- GROK-HD-FALCON-1000: 1235 images (1343 files). MANIFEST.csv sha256 9199567bb5476d0f7a2419d810f862f170a670d7a0ea4d6139b3f063a8df1679
- GROK-HD-ENABLERS-03: 808 images (893 files). MANIFEST.csv sha256 e12e5f0babe2e42c19002f3eda40d400a407952c12eabffb5fa283c12059c986
Everything is preliminary, and nothing is accepted until Nova intake or Ziggy accepts it.
